# 5 AI Meeting Transcription Tools Compared in 2026: Fathom vs Granola vs Fireflies vs Otter vs Gong

I record roughly 20 meetings a week. Client calls, discovery sessions, partnership talks. For a solopreneur, every meeting is a potential revenue event, and I cannot afford to forget what was said. For years I took handwritten notes. Then I manually transcribed recordings, eating 2–3 hours per week. In 2026, AI meeting transcription is finally good enough that I trust the bot while I focus on the conversation.

I tested five tools — Fathom, Granola, Fireflies, Otter AI, and Gong — on real client calls over four weeks. Here’s the honest breakdown.

## How I Tested

I ran each tool through five real calls: a 45-minute client discovery (heavy industry jargon), a 30-minute negotiation (pricing, legal terms), a 60-minute group brainstorm (6 participants), a 20-minute one-on-one (casual, filler words), and a 50-minute product demo (technical terms). Accuracy scores are word-error-rate against a human-verified reference.

## The Detailed Breakdown

### 1. Fathom — Best Free Option (Zoom Users)

**Price:** Free (unlimited recordings and transcriptions)

Fathom is an outlier: genuinely free with no hidden limits. I’ve recorded 80+ meetings on the free tier. Auto-generated summaries structure every meeting into Key Takeaways, Action Items, and Next Steps. One-click sharing posts the link to Slack. HubSpot integration logs meetings automatically.

**Accuracy:** 92% overall, 87% on technical jargon.
**Limitations:** No Teams support. No mobile app. Desktop/browser only.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who live in Zoom and want a completely free solution.

### 2. Granola — Notes That Learn Your Style

**Price:** $19/month (7-day trial)

Granola generates notes styled to match your voice. After about 10 meetings of corrections, summaries read like you wrote them. Processes audio locally for privacy — no cloud storage of recordings.

**Accuracy:** 95% overall, second-best in test. Handled technical jargon better than Fathom or Fireflies.
**Limitations:** No integrations beyond calendar sync. No Slack, Notion, or CRM. No mobile app. Desktop-only (Mac now, Windows in beta).

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who value beautifully written notes and are okay with a 2-week training period.

### 3. Fireflies — Multi-Platform Workhorse

**Price:** Free (14-day trial), Pro at $10/month, Business at $19/month

Fireflies works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and dial-in calls. Search across all transcripts by keyword, speaker, or date. Soundbites let you clip specific moments and share audio snippets. 50+ integrations.

**Accuracy:** 90% overall. Struggled with 5+ participant calls — occasionally attributed comments to wrong speakers.
**Limitations:** Free tier is only 14 days. UI is overwhelming with too many tabs.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs meeting across Zoom, Meet, AND Teams who want a single capture tool.

### 4. Otter AI — Real-Time Transcription Pioneer

**Price:** Free (300 min/month), Pro at $16.99/month, Business at $30/month

Fastest real-time transcription I tested — words appear in under a second. Meeting Gist generates one-paragraph summaries instantly. Excellent mobile app for transcribing in-person meetings. Speaker identification correctly labeled 6 speakers in my group test — best in class.

**Accuracy:** 93% overall.
**Limitations:** 300 min/month free tier runs out fast (about 10 meetings). No Teams on free or Pro. UI has gotten cluttered with upsells.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who want live captions during calls and need mobile transcription.

### 5. Gong — Enterprise Revenue Intelligence

**Price:** Starting at $150+/month (custom pricing)

Gong is not just transcription — it’s revenue intelligence. Analyzes every customer conversation to identify buying signals, objection patterns, and competitive mentions. In my tests, it surfaced that the word timeline appeared 3x more in won deals than lost deals. Highest accuracy in the test.

**Accuracy:** 96% overall. Best on accents, fast talkers, and technical jargon.
**Limitations:** $150+/month is prohibitive for most solopreneurs. Overkill for a solo operation. Setup took 2 hours plus a week for AI calibration.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs past $10k+/month who want systematic sales conversation analysis.

## Use Case Recommendations

**Bootstrapped and every dollar counts:** Fathom (free). Perfect for Zoom/Meet with HubSpot integration.

**Beautiful notes that sound like you:** Granola ($19/mo). Worth it after 2-week training period. Be ready to copy-paste manually.

**Use Zoom, Meet, AND Teams:** Fireflies ($10/mo). Unmatched platform coverage and cross-transcript search.

**Need real-time captions during calls:** Otter AI ($16.99/mo). Fastest live transcription plus mobile app.

**Scaling past $10k/month and want sales optimization:** Gong ($150+/mo). Pays for itself if it helps close one extra deal per quarter.

## FAQ

### Are AI transcription summaries accurate enough to send to clients?

Yes, with review. Fathom’s summaries are client-ready about 70% of the time. Gong’s are closer to 90%. Always review action items before hitting send — a quick 2-minute check is worth the peace of mind.

### Which tool has the best free tier?

Fathom, by far. Unlimited recordings on Zoom and Google Meet with no caps. Otter’s 300 min/month is second-best but runs out by mid-month.

### Do these work with pre-recorded files?

Otter and Fireflies support uploading pre-recorded audio/video. Fathom and Granola are live-only. Gong supports uploads at the enterprise tier.

### What about data privacy?

Granola processes audio locally — no cloud storage. Fathom and Fireflies store transcripts with SOC 2 compliance. Gong uses data for model training unless you opt out. Always check data retention policies before recording sensitive client calls.

### Can I use these for non-English meetings?

All five support multiple languages, but accuracy drops. Fathom tested at 85% on Spanish versus 92% on English. Gong has the best non-English accuracy. Otter drops below 85% for non-English.

## Summary

If I had to pick one tool for a solopreneur right now, it would be Fathom — because it’s free, excellent, and covers Zoom and Google Meet. The unlimited free tier removes all friction.

Need Teams coverage? Pay $10/month for Fireflies. Want the most beautiful notes? Pay $19/month for Granola. Scaling past $10k/month? Gong pays for itself in improved close rates.

The real unlock: AI meeting transcription frees 2–3 hours per week I used to spend on manual notes. That’s 8–12 hours per month. Nearly two full working weeks a year saved. For a solopreneur, that’s the difference between surviving and scaling.
